src='''from collections import Counter


def _components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0] or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = set()
            while stack:
                p = stack.pop()
                cells.add(p)
                for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    q = (p[0] + dr, p[1] + dc)
                    if (0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and q not in seen
                            and grid[q[0]][q[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            result.append((color, cells))
    return result


def _corner(cells):
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    if r0 == r1 or c0 == c1:
        return None
    for r, c in ((r0, c0), (r0, c1), (r1, c0), (r1, c1)):
        line = {(r, x) for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)} | {(y, c) for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)}
        if cells == line:
            return r, c
    return None


def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    components = _components(grid)
    corners = [(color, cells, _corner(cells)) for color, cells in components]
    corners = [(color, cells, p) for color, cells, p in corners if p is not None]
    if not corners:
        return out
    color, marker, (cr, cc) = max(corners, key=lambda item: len(item[1]))
    # The object in the upper-left sector nearest the corner is the one marked.
    candidates = [(obj_color, cells) for obj_color, cells in components
                  if cells != marker and all(r < cr and c < cc for r, c in cells)]
    if candidates:
        _, target = min(candidates, key=lambda item: min((cr-r)+(cc-c) for r, c in item[1]))
        for r, c in target:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out

def subshape(target, source):

 for dr in range(-max(r for r,c in q), max(r for r,c in p)+1):
  for dc in range(-max(c for r,c in q), max(c for r,c in p)+1):
   if {(dr+r,dc+c) for r,c in q}<=p:return True
 return False

def quadrant(box, corner):
 r0,c0,r1,c1=box; cr,cc=corner
 rm=(r0+r1)/2; cm=(c0+c1)/2
 return (-1 if rm<cr else 1, -1 if cm<cc else 1)
